text:
Lina (UX): Quick design nit from support: Project Settings shows `Retention: 30d` and `KMS: BYOK` on one line. Customers ask whether that's policy or actual retention.
Tom (Design): Agree. Split into two compact lines: 
- Policy: 30 days
- Effective: 18 days (route override)
Also change `BYOK` to first-run full: 'Customer-managed key (BYOK)'.
Rhea (Security): Also: audit log text is inconsistent. Replace vague entries like 'kms_update' with canonical human + machine pair: `kms.rotate` -> 'KMS key rotated  user: rhea@example.com (console)'. Include key fingerprint in metadata.
Kai (Frontend): Implementation notes: add i18n keys `settings.kms.full_label` and `settings.retention.summary`. Use `aria-describedby` linking the 'What's this?' help to the effective line. Add `data-event-code` attribute on audit rows so SIEMs can filter.
Tom (Design): Accessibility: don't rely on color. Add a small lock icon and explicit text inside the pill: 'Customer-managed key (BYOK) e Active'. For contrast use navy bg + white text for Active, light gray + dark text for Disabled.
Lina (UX): Microcopy options for the compact row to A/B test: 'Policy: 30d  Effective: 18d' OR 'Policy 30d  Effective 18d (overridden)'.
ci-bot: Deploy scheduled: microcopy PR #537 to staging at 1972468010.
Rhea (Security): I'll add the audit schema snippet to docs and include example SIEM mappings.
Kai (Frontend): I'll open a tiny PR with aria changes and data attributes behind a feature flag. ETA EOD.
